fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM82,820. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0004675/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: STPM/A-level with at least a C (CGPA 2.00) in two (2) subjects; OR STAM with at least Jayyid; OR Matriculation/Foundation/Diploma (MQF Level 4) with at least CGPA 2.00; OR UEC with at least Grade B in five (5) subjects; OR SAM with at least 65%-70%; OR CPU with at least 80% aggregate; OR Other qualifications recognized by the Government of Malaysia. Pass interview and drawing test by MSU (except for History and Design programmes); MUET Band 3.
